environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7.x application deployed on Amazon EC2 (Amazon Linux 2) behind a basic NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). SELinux is in permissive mode (setenforce 0 was run during deployment for compatibility). Application runs as ec2-user with standard filesystem permissions. No WAF or header inspection is configured. Tomcat embedded server with default configuration, no response header filtering.
